title: What Do RTL Repair Benchmarks Actually Measure?
abstract: arXiv:2610.28595v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: RTL repair benchmarks should measure whether a model can fix broken RTL given a specification. To this end, we construct and hash-bind RTLRepairDataset, 5,784 (broken, fixed) training pairs; RTLRepairBench, 459 held-out cases with 374 syntactic and 85 behavioral mutations; and an evaluation harness supporting simulation and formal equivalence. We then use this infrastructure to identify two measurement confounds. First, simulation and formal scoring give opposite signs for the apparent effect of providing a specification in one evaluated cohort; reset-aware rescoring attributes almost all of the simulation-formal disagreement to reset and first-cycle comparison semantics. Second, on 274 mined model failures, the specification-only minus specification-conditioned recovery point estimate ranges from -8.5 to +18.3 percentage points across six models. Thus, a conventional repair score need not isolate whether the model used the faulty RTL. W

translated_title: RTL修复基准究竟在测量什么？
translated_abstract: RTL修复基准应当测量模型能否根据规范修复损坏的RTL（寄存器传输级）代码。为此，我们构建并通过哈希绑定的方式锁定了RTLRepairDataset（包含5,784对“损坏-修复”训练样本对）、RTLRepairBench（包含459个留出测试用例，其中374个为语法变异、85个为行为变异），以及一个支持仿真与形式化等价验证的评测框架。随后，我们利用这一基础设施识别出两个测量混淆因素。第一，在一个评估队列中，仿真评分与形式化评分对于“是否提供规范”这一因素的表观影响给出了相反的符号；经重置感知的重评分后，几乎所有仿真与形式化评分之间的不一致都可归因于重置语义和首周期比较语义。第二，在274个挖掘出的模型失败案例中，“仅规范”减去“规范条件化”的恢复率点估计在六个模型之间的变化范围为-8.5至+18.3个百分点。因此，传统的修复分数并不一定能够隔离出模型是否真正利用了损坏的RTL。
tldr: 本文构建了RTL修复数据集与评测基准，并揭示传统修复分数存在测量混淆——仿真与形式化评分因重置语义而对“提供规范”的影响给出相反结论，且修复分数无法隔离模型是否真正利用了损坏的RTL——从而质疑了现有RTL修复基准的实际测量能力。
en_tdlr: By constructing RTL repair datasets and an evaluation harness, this paper reveals two measurement confounds—simulation-formal scoring disagreement caused by reset semantics and repair scores that fail to isolate whether the model actually used the faulty RTL—questioning what conventional RTL repair benchmarks genuinely measure.
